Jamun Powder Price: Spray Dried Jamun Powder for Food and Herbal Brands

Jamun, also called Indian black plum (Syzygium cumini), is a dark purple fruit with a sweet, tangy and slightly astringent taste. If you need a dependable jamun powder supplier, Tradenest Naturals offers spray dried jamun powder for food, beverage and herbal product manufacturers. Spray drying turns the fruit juice into a fine powder that keeps its natural deep colour and distinct flavour. Jamun is also traditionally used in Ayurvedic formulations, so herbal brands often ask us for it.

Why Choose Our Spray Dried Black Plum Powder?

Our process is simple and carefully controlled. First, we use ripe jamun fruit, carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. Next, the fruit is destoned and the juice is extracted. Finally, the juice is spray dried into a fine, free-flowing powder that dissolves well in water. The result is a nutraceutical grade jamun powder suitable for supplement blends as well as foods and drinks. Compared with drum-dried alternatives, spray dried powder usually has a finer texture and better solubility. The exact composition, including any drying carrier used, is stated in the product specification sheet.

Processing and Quality Control

At Tradenest Naturals, consistency is the main goal. Our team checks moisture, colour and particle size for every batch. We follow hygienic handling practices from fruit receipt to packing. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. We also know that jamun powder price matters to your business. That is why we keep our supply chain lean and quote fair wholesale rates, with a minimum order of only 5 Kg.

Applications in Food and Herbal Products

Our wholesale spray dried jamun powder is used in many sectors. Beverage makers add it to fruit drinks, coolers and instant mixes. Supplement and herbal brands use it in capsules, tablets and powder blends, often in traditional Ayurvedic formulations. Thanks to its fine mesh, it also blends easily into yogurts, ice creams and confectionery. If you are looking for a bulk jamun powder manufacturer, we can supply trial lots and repeat bulk orders alike.

Detailed Product Specifications

We share our technical data openly. The powder is sieved to a fine mesh for easy dispersion. Moisture is kept low to prevent clumping. Below are the standard parameters for our spray dried product:
  • Mesh Size: 80-100 Mesh for good solubility.
  • Moisture Content: < 5% for stability.
  • Processing: Spray dried from jamun fruit juice.
  • Solubility: Dissolves readily in water and other liquids.

A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. What are the packaging and shelf-life options? Use our contact form or write to our sales team. Samples are available on request, and we reply with a formal quotation.
